hero.subTitle: Trusted by Nature
hero.description: From bulk export to fully custom private label manufacturing, we deliver premium, tested and certified products and ingredients — the way global food and wellness brands need them.

categories.title: What We Offer
categories.editableSeedsDesc: Faar Earth is a trusted edible seeds supplier and exporter from India, offering premium basil seeds, flaxseeds, pumpkin seeds and melon seeds for the global nutrition, bakery and health-food industry. Every batch is sourced and quality-tested to meet international food-safety standards, making us a preferred edible seeds manufacturer for brands that demand consistency at export scale.
categories.coldPressedOilsDesc: As a leading cold pressed oils supplier from India, Faar Earth delivers unrefined, nutrient-rich oils including moringa oil, castor oil, jojoba oil, hemp seed oil, almond oil, sesame oil, black seed oil and virgin coconut oil. Our cold pressed oil is supplied to cosmetic, wellness and food-processing partners worldwide, with private label and bulk packaging options available.
categories.whiteLabellingDesc: Faar Earth is a full-scale private label manufacturer in India, helping health, nutrition and food brands launch their own product lines without the complexity of building a manufacturing setup from scratch. From custom formulation to white label packaging, we act as your OEM manufacturing partner from raw material sourcing to export-ready finished goods.

products.title: A Glimpse of Our Range
products.description1: We are sourcing the best of seeds, spices, nuts, oils, botanicals, naturally derived food additives, plant-based protein powders, plant extracts, and freeze dried fruits and vegetables — pairing this with a decade of experience in the packaging industry to give our clients the product they want, the way they want it, including private label and white-label solutions.
products.description2: As a business, we constantly strive to not only keep up with the latest developments in health and food industries, but also work with our partners to develop products that can create better end-products and make a meaningful impact.
products.description3: We do not just chase transactions; we build supply chains. We actively seek long-term, contractual partnerships with global food processors to ensure a consistent, predictable, and price-stable supply of raw materials, mitigating the risks of global market volatility.
products.pumpkinSeedsDesc: Hulled, sun-dried pumpkin seeds packed with natural oils and minerals.

products.sweetenersDesc: Naturally derived sweeteners processed and packed to meet global food industry standards.

about.title: Rooted In Nature
about.subTitle: Committed to Quality
about.description1: At Faar Earth, we strive to provide the best of ingredients to food processing industries globally. We are a premier, India-based export enterprise specialising in sourcing, processing and delivery of high-quality agricultural ingredients and plant-based solutions.
about.description2: We bridge the gap between India's rich agricultural biodiversity and stringent global quality standards. Headed by two people combining very complimentary skillsets of a seasoned corporate veteran and someone who grew up in an Indian family business, we offer seamless, reliable and highly scalable supply chain solutions designed for modern food manufacturers.

howToOrder.intro: A straightforward path from enquiry to shipment — designed so your quality and procurement teams have what they need at each stage before committing to volume.
howToOrder.step1Desc: Share product, quantity, and any specification requirement (mesh size, viscosity, assay %, certification needed).
howToOrder.step2Desc: We send technical specifications and a sample for your team's evaluation, along with indicative COA.
howToOrder.step3Desc: Agree quantity, price (FOB/CIF as required), and lead time.
howToOrder.step4Desc: COA, Certificate of Origin, and any requested testing/phytosanitary certification issued ahead of dispatch.
howToOrder.step5Desc: Order processed within the stated category lead time.
howToOrder.step6Desc: Full export documentation provided to support your import clearance.
